records.query: Need the patient's electrocardiogram or continuous telemetry tracings during the hypotensive episode, along with flecainide dose, dosing interval, and serum drug level if available, plus recent electrolyte panel, to confirm whether the rapid rhythm is an arrhythmia directly causing hypotension and to assess possible flecainide proarrhythmia.
records.text:

records.query: Need the patient's baseline ECG and echocardiogram, along with flecainide dose, dosing interval, and serum drug level if available, plus continuous telemetry correlating the hypotensive episode with the tachycardia, to confirm the arrhythmia as the direct cause of hypotension and distinguish flecainide proarrhythmia from structural heart disease.

Need the patient's baseline ECG and echocardiogram to exclude structural heart disease, plus flecainide dose, dosing interval, and serum drug level to assess proarrhythmia, and continuous telemetry correlating the hypotensive episode with tachycardia onset to confirm arrhythmia-related hypotension.

Need baseline ECG and echocardiogram to rule out structural heart disease, flecainide serum concentration and dosing history to assess proarrhythmia, and telemetry strips correlating the onset of hypotension with the narrow-to-wide complex transition to confirm SVT with aberrancy as the direct cause.

bindings.label: Patient presented to the emergency department with complaints of dizziness
Patient in their 70s with history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and structurally normal heart was prescribed flecainide 100 mg twice a day for rhythm control
Physical examination: blood pressure 60/44 mm Hg, heart rate 166 beats/min, oxygen saturation 100% on ambient air
ECG shows regular monomorphic wide complex tachycardia at 160 bpm with QRS duration 180 ms and rS interval 100 ms in V6
ECG shows transition from narrow to wide complex at the same cycle length
The wide complex tachycardia is supraventricular tachycardia with aberrant conduction
The wide complex tachycardia is monomorphic ventricular tachycardia
Baseline ECG, echocardiogram, and flecainide drug levels are unavailable; structural heart disease has not been definitively excluded
Hypotension due to supraventricular tachycardia with aberrant conduction
Hypotension due to monomorphic ventricular tachycardia
